name: SALT Triage VR Simulation
description: Virtual reality simulation for training the SALT (Sort, Assess, Lifesaving interventions, Treatment/Transport) mass casualty triage protocol. Published in BMC Digital Health (2024). Models chaotic mass casualty incident dynamics for first responder training, enabling repeated practice of high-stakes triage decisions in a safe VR environment.
domain: mass casualty triage, first responder training, emergency medicine
difficulty_level: professional (first responders and emergency medical personnel)
reputation: academic research tool; published in peer-reviewed venue (BMC Digital Health, 2024)
notes: Academic VR simulation tool. SALT protocol is US national standard for mass casualty triage. VR format enables scalable training without requiring live patient simulation resources.
